comment: The group and master CV cable carries the group mutes, then the group solos, then master mute, dim and mono, and then one more channel read as the master volume CV at a tenth of a volt per unit. With poly-spread on, a polyphonic cable on the first track volume jack or the first track pan jack is spread one channel per track, and the other track jacks are read as one channel each.
